theme_and_brand.identity: Sutan Khulifah Academy - Perjalanan Ruhani. Refleksi Kehidupan. Transformasi Diri. Luxury, spiritual, and elegant Point of Sale and Inventory Management SaaS.

headings.description: Used for main titles, auth screen greetings, and major section headers to evoke spiritual luxury and elegant aesthetics.

body_and_ui.description: Used for all POS data, inventory tables, dense dashboards, and numeric values. Clean and highly legible.

layouts_and_spacing.philosophy: High-density elegance. Ensure adequate spacing inside cards (p-6) but keep grid gaps tight (gap-4) for dashboard scanability.

pos_terminal_layout.structure: Split screen layout. Left 70% for Category Tabs and Product Bento Grid. Right 30% for Sticky Checkout/Cart Panel.
pos_terminal_layout.cart_panel: Fixed height, solid surface with gold border-l. Flex-col with flex-1 for scrollable items, sticky bottom for totals and massive Gold Pay button.

dashboard_layout.structure: Sidebar navigation (solid deep black with subtle gold accents) + main content area.
dashboard_layout.metrics_bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Use sharp edges or max 8px radius.

cards.style: Flat solid surfaces (#111111). NO card shadow in dark mode. 1px border using border_subtle.
cards.radius: rounded-lg (8px) maximum to keep it sharp and premium.

buttons.primary: Solid Gold (#D4AF37) background, deep black (#050505) text. Hover: Bright Gold (#FFD700). Transition: transform 0.2s ease.
buttons.secondary: Transparent background, 1px Gold border, Gold text. Hover: bg-gold/10.

inputs_and_forms.style: Solid dark background (#0A0A0A) with border_subtle. Focus state MUST have ring-1 ring-[#D4AF37]. Text text_primary.

tables.style: Shadcn tables. Header text text_secondary uppercase tracking-wider text-xs. Row borders border_subtle.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: All interactive elements must change color. Cards translate-y-[-2px] with border color shift to border_active.
motion_and_interaction.transitions: transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out is FORBIDDEN. Use targeted transitions (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
motion_and_interaction.pos_interactions: Adding item to cart should have a micro-bounce effect or a subtle toast notification using Sonner.

brand_logo.description: Sutan Khulifah Academy main logo. Place prominently in Auth screen and Sidebar top.

products_retail_elegant.description: Elegant clothing display for product placeholder

store_interiors.description: Luxury boutique interior for dashboard backgrounds or onboarding screen

iconography_and_libraries.icons: Use lucide-react. Ensure stroke-width is 1.5 for a finer, more elegant look.
iconography_and_libraries.charts: Use recharts wrapped in Shadcn chart component. Colors must use primary_gold and ivory.
iconography_and_libraries.toasts: Use Sonner for all POS success/error notifications. Styled to match dark/gold theme.

universal_rules: Target .js files only, do not output .tsx files.
NEVER use generic placeholder text or empty dummy images. Always use provided Unsplash URLs.
CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cart items, nav links) MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='pos-checkout-btn').
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it. Always apply a solid dark color or backdrop-blur with bg-[#050505]/90.
Avoid 'transition: all' in CSS. Specify properties like 'transition-colors' or 'transition-transform'.
Do not center-align standard form inputs or text content; left-align them for readability.
Do not over-round corners. The elegant luxury vibe requires max rounded-md or rounded-lg.
Implement both Auth flow (login with role selection), Onboarding, and full POS / Dashboard (Products, Inventory, Sales, multi-branch) layouts.
